test_source_requirements: The test file is standalone and may use only the Python standard library plus the exact bound pure-core path after later execution authorization.
Independent reference arithmetic must not call private pure-core helpers or copy their normalized function bodies.
Positive controls independently construct ordinary prime-field curves and sorted sign-complete six-point factor bases.
Tests compare returned chart fixture, all 21 pair classifications, 18 retained witnesses, fibers, representatives, diagnostics, and every successful CoreOps component to an independent reference.
Negative controls cover every public error code, first-error precedence, exact indices, and charged failure prefix.
Mutation-oriented assertions cover chart-scalar congruence, source-label sorting, vertical-pair exclusion, least-slope selection, and immutability.
The file contains no registered seed, campaign wrapper, evidence writer, filesystem output, network access, subprocess, or cryptanalytic claim.
After the test source is committed, three fresh exact-test-source reviews and a separate Coordinator execution decision are required before import, compilation, or test execution.
test_source_authorization.transition_rule: After three distinct exact-commit GO reviews of this V10 design, the active Coordinator may commit a decision authorizing creation of only the one test-source path. Review GO alone changes no authority.
